title: Wire the signup form to the provisioning API
notes: Form is built, the endpoint exists. Needs the error states and the account-creation call. Nothing else in the flow works until this is done.

title: Write the design-partner onboarding email
notes: Three partners are waiting for the link. We told them Thursday on last week's call.

title: Fix the flaky signup E2E test
notes: Fails about one run in five on the email-confirmation step. Everyone re-runs CI instead of fixing it.

title: Upgrade the billing SDK to 4.2
notes: Current version stops receiving security patches in two months. Mechanical upgrade, but the webhook signature changed.

title: Migrate the events table to partitions
notes: Weeks of work: needs a maintenance window, a dual-write period, and sign-off from the data team.

title: Approve Raj's access request for the staging vault
notes: One click. Raj cannot test the signup provisioning until it is approved; he asked on Monday.

title: Rewrite the onboarding docs page
notes: Current page describes the old invite-only flow, which contradicts what self-serve users will see.

title: Answer the security questionnaire from Northwind
notes: Procurement blocked on it. We committed to returning it this week in the contract call.

title: Clean up the dead feature flags
notes: Fourteen flags that have been fully rolled out for months. Every one left in place is another branch in the code.

title: Review Priya's PR for the rate limiter
notes: Open since Tuesday. She cannot merge the dependent change until someone reviews it.

title: Set up the signup conversion funnel in analytics
notes: We will want to know where partners drop off, but nothing breaks if it lands after the demo.

title: Renew the TLS certificate for the staging domain
notes: Expires at the end of the month. Auto-renewal has failed twice; the manual path takes ten minutes.

title: Prototype the team-workspace concept
notes: Exploratory. No customer has asked for it yet; it came out of the offsite.

title: Add password-reset to the signup flow
notes: Partners will create accounts and some of them will immediately forget the password. Not strictly required for the first demo.

title: File the quarterly accessibility audit report
notes: Due to the external auditor. We signed a commitment to deliver it every quarter.

title: Refactor the notification service into modules
notes: One 4,000-line file. Nobody is blocked, but every change to it is slower than the last.

title: Turn off the legacy invite endpoint
notes: Once self-serve works, the old endpoint is a second way in with different validation. Cannot be removed before the new flow is live.

title: Book the venue for the team offsite
notes: Prices go up and the good dates disappear the longer we leave it. Nobody is blocked on it today.
